name: CritDigestSelftest
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack I2/I3 receipt digest and graded selftest binding: mutate the suite digest after a run; insert a duplicate case line and reorder cases. Run against the committed tree in isolated scratch; show exact receipt/transcript and whether I2/I3 red. Any green defect must be reproducible.

name: MutScratchTiming
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack I6 scratch scanning: create a family-named stray only after the scan, and place a stray in /tmp or /var/tmp outside the configured root. Run the committed suite in scratch and record exact results, including whether the frozen kill rule routes either escape.

name: CritDeclarationCoverage
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack I5/I12 declared-blocks completeness: add an undeclared append-only change to SCORECARD.md and a changed file omitted from declared-blocks. Run the suite and show whether it still closes; any passing defect is a kill-rule survivor.

name: MutFreshnessCensus
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack registry freshness: make S063 overdue and add a duplicate registry URL with the word `supersedes` but no valid target. Determine whether sources-census validate catches either and whether the frozen C2 kill rule names these cases. Preserve exact scratch diffs/transcripts.

name: CritLessonTally
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Audit round-40 lesson erratum arithmetic and C1 record corrections for conflicting wave/round totals. Also change a correction's exact evidence filename to a plausible `.md` path. Verify I1/I4 behavior and report reproductions.

name: LabCaptureTruth
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Challenge C2 source truth: construct a self-consistent fake capture with planted quotes, and a genuine capture with the required quote omitted. Run source-recheck and capture-binding instruments and show the outputs; distinguish instrument consistency from upstream truth.

name: MutBindingExistence
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack capture-binding-check record-to-file existence: mutate the S063 manifest record path to a missing capture while preserving URL fields, then case-change/trailing-slash the URL. Run relevant checks and report exact red/green outcomes.

name: CritRegistryRecordCompleteness
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack C2 structural registration: remove S063's manifest record while leaving the mined row, and conversely leave a manifest record with no mined row. Run capture binding and census, then judge whether frozen C2 kill clauses catch both.

name: MutAuditUnexpected
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack recheck-audit unexpected-entry coverage: add an unlisted markdown knowledge file and create an unreferenced mined registry row. Run recheck-audit and capture-binding; record whether either silent orphan survives.

name: CritUpstreamAuthenticity
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Challenge the external authenticity limit of the S063 capture and entry: use the live RFC source as the oracle, compare every claimed fact and exact quote against source text, and distinguish what source-recheck can prove from what it cannot. Report mismatch with URL, time, and anchor.

name: MutExportRecheck
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Test the entry's `recheck:` command from a clean exported tree rather than the lane cwd. Record the exact invocation and failure/success; determine whether it is truly portable or hard-codes a lane path.

name: RevCaptureNormalization
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Independently compare S063 fetched raw bytes, normalized capture bytes, manifest metadata, and source-recheck semantics, including BOM preservation and line counts. Re-derive digests and report any mismatch or misleading claim.

name: CritProvinceBoundary
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Review F24's researcher-side domain boundary against the neighboring sibling lane scope. Determine whether the new province amendment remains within kasegi's declared domain, with source-backed evidence; do not infer permission or target behavior from RFC 9116.

name: MutFrontierParser
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack frontier-recheck-count row counting: add a comment/formatted line that matches its `^| F[0-9]+ |` pattern without a valid admitted entry. Run the counter and show if it counts the decoy; relate only to the frozen C2 predicate.

name: CritReceiptBootstrap
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Probe C1 receipt bootstrap at the judged head: run the suite at J with and without `--receipt-out`, inspect whether I2 seeds the missing receipt correctly, then verify the resulting transcript is byte-stable for the later Y-only receipt commit. Preserve exact outputs.

name: MutSelftestBaseline
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack I8/H5 baseline generation: alter the selftest's synthetic pristine receipt so it is generated internally rather than read from committed artifact bytes. Run selftest and identify whether its positive control remains vacuous or whether a case fails.

name: RevRunUtc
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Re-derive receipt run-utc and time-basis using committer epoch and ISO timestamp; test a timezone-offset commit timestamp and a future GIT_COMMITTER_DATE. Report whether the I2 predicates bind the intended commit instant and wall-clock limit.

name: MutExportRefReemit
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Test Y-level receipt re-emission with altered export-ref. Determine whether the suite re-reads the current target ref or trusts the receipt's named ref, and whether ancestor/diff-clean checks catch the mutation. Give exact output.

name: CritCommitTimestamp
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Challenge time-basis=ref-commit against arbitrary committer-date metadata within the 120-second future allowance. Construct a sandbox commit and test the suite; report exact bound and its implications without changing the frozen claim.

name: MutAncestorGuard
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Mutate receipt export-ref to a valid non-ancestor commit and to a nonexistent commit. Run I2/I8 selftests and export suite; verify the ancestor and ref-not-found limbs distinctly reject both.

name: CritYDeltaClean
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Add a tracked unrelated file beside the receipt between J and Y. Run I2 and determine whether diff-clean requires exactly the receipt path as the sole delta. Include commit graph/diff evidence.

name: MutSkillTablePipes
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Attack I7 registry parser with a blank line before the suite row, a bare pipe in an entry command, leading whitespace in the first cell, and a row outside the contiguous table. Test each mutation separately and report which are killed.

name: RevErratumLanding
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Review the appended D4/D5 erratum against committed round-40 lesson bytes: ensure it fixes duplicated Gate, garbled census and 25/35 arithmetic without rewriting history. Recount the dispatch attack roles from the committed JSON and report exact findings.

name: CritI12Necessity
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Assess I12's declared-blocks whole-tail limb against the frozen kill rule: identify which committed round-40 routed defect requires it, whether the fixture truly demonstrates the relevant failure, and whether the predicate can be reached by a do-nothing control.

name: RevScanOwnership
prompt:
/skill:godspeed

Review I6/I11 scratch-scan ownership and F1-F8 committed escape fixtures. Re-run each state and test the claimed dual-ownership/disable-I6 attack; report exact payloads and any unowned survivor.
